findings.finding: The catalog declares official_pdf_fill while the Louisiana Legislature publishes Article 987 as codified text rather than an issuer fillable PDF.
findings.treatment: The existing LA-STATUTORY-FORMS COMPOSE_FROM_AUTHORITY decision is bound together with the governed source-adoption record and exact held Article 986, 978.1, and 987 hashes.

findings.finding: The authoritative component set contains one primary-filing component and one instructions component.
findings.treatment: Both components are rendered in authoritative order in the canonical and boundary packets, and every packet page is assigned in the component-page manifest.

findings.finding: The participant owns the assertions that the deferred-sentence period ran and probation was successfully completed.
findings.treatment: The renderer refuses to generate the prescribed allegation unless both case-specific confirmations are true; the fixture confirmations are explicitly synthetic and are not inferred from route selection.

findings.finding: The Rule to Show Cause and Order of Dismissal contain court-owned return, date, place, service-address, and signature fields.
findings.treatment: Every such field remains protected. The prescribed proposed-order recitals and decretal sentence remain printed, while no judicial execution field is written.

findings.finding: Article 978.1 requires four actual participant/case documents for a later Article 978 felony-expungement filing.
findings.treatment: A dedicated status record distinguishes required, provided, not provided, and stale inputs; validates the 60-day background-check rule and allowed document kinds; preserves the later-stage boundary; and requires private upload or authorized handoff instead of fabrication.

findings.finding: Article 987 is a predicate filing, not an expungement, and parish motion costs are not fixed by the committed record.
findings.treatment: The participant and filing instructions state the destination, fee uncertainty, lack of an Article 987 waiver, service and notice rules, post-order expungement step, and every committed self-help stop.
